messages.subject: Re: Rebound Body Studio — the site is now 14 pages, and I need five codes from you
messages.body:
Hi, Phil!!!

This is so awesome whaaaat! Thanks so much!!!

I know it’s sports/orthopedic massage with a not very sporty logo lol since
we’re located in salon suites, I didn’t want the vibe to seem
unapproachable to the kind of people who get their like eyebrows done or
whatever, like salon people. I didn’t get to see the earlier versions
because I was asleep lol but you could add more dark blue colors to make it
look more sporty/ortho if you think you should? But it seems great!

How do you know so much about massage already! All the info is great! I
have to read in more detail but I haven’t seen any issues info-wise so far.
*Howeverrrrr*, I would want to take out the part about scar tissue in the
section on what massage doesn’t do. Not because it’s wrong, but *a lotttt*
of my clients need/receive scar tissue work, and I don’t want them to think
I’m not actually helping. I know it’s all in the fascia and nerves and I’m
not like actually removing scar tissue, but massage can help people feel
tremendously better when I work on scar tissue areas.

Oh, right. One big thing—Brian doesn’t work at Rebound anymore 😬 sorry, I
deleted him from Staff last night but maybe the website did the thing where
it remembered old info? And so then I’m not sure about keeping prenatal on
there. Technically you don’t legally need to be certified in it here (I’m
pretty sure….) so I *could *take a course online and still offer prenatal….
Or it could be a different kind of service, like.. “myofascial unwinding”
or something… It seems nice to have six services because of the layout.

MassageBook! I’ll switch the permissions things! I’ll get that done today!

Photos! Yes, I need photos lol. On Google too. I was waiting until I could
set up the room completely, and I hung the art I was waiting on on Monday,
so it’s ready enough now to be photographed! Maybe we can figure out a time
for Wendy to be there too. She didn’t have any photos of herself when I
asked be
